title: TrackerHubSyncService
responsibility: Handle authenticated Tracker journal sync, health, due permission, and machine telemetry requests using injected stores.

inputs.name: TrackerHubSyncService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Provides the TrackerHMAC verifier and journal. Optional collaborators provide machine and run stores, due policy, due grants and the observation clock.

inputs.name: TrackerHubSyncService.handle.request
inputs.description: The HTTP method, original path and query, headers, optional UTF-8 POST stream and optional transport cancellation signal.

outputs.name: TrackerHubSyncService.handle
outputs.description: The route-specific JSON response or a fixed JSON error with HTTP 400, 401, 404, 413 or 500.

outputs.name: TrackerHubSyncService.peers
outputs.description: A fresh snapshot mapping node labels reported by authenticated callers to their last contact time in ISO format.

errors.name: request.signal.reason
errors.description: The supplied abort reason when the transport cancels before handling or while a body read or poll is pending.
